execution.scope: Native-instructions host file within the full root run

assertions: Official producer discovers project and both global synthetic AGENTS files
One first-turn model request
Successful synthetic read triggers one official refresh and exactly two model requests in its tool turn
Original raw event prefix preserved
Only exact user agent-instructions instructions source removed
Human, other plugin and other form retained
Repeated baseline discovery and read refresh cause no extra model loop
Restored user data equals original data
Restoration cites placeholder and original sequences
Whitespace rule and prompt count as empty
Nonempty saved prompt suppresses native instructions
Disabling control restores native instructions
Shared producer supports concurrent suppressed and preserved sessions
Model-specific rule takes precedence over active rule
A selected blank model rule allows fallback despite a different nonempty active rule
Reject decision object identity retained
Rejected turn is blocked without a model call
Official loop cancellation ends as aborted
Unload restores currently visible owned placeholders during request preparation
Already waiting request callback creates no late policy writes
Request uses restored canonical history
Official AgentHandle.dispose restores before persistence handle closes
Physical JSONL readback equals committed events after disposal
Official Session reconstruction retains native instructions and original audit markers
Subsequent owner replacement remains visible
Hidden original owned by later replacement is not revived
All remaining visible plugin placeholders restore
Official producer continues after plugin unload without a plugin projection definition
Public DesktopRuntime.apply activates nativeInstructions capability
Strict request excludes native instructions while real system prompt composition uses the operator prompt
Public DesktopRuntime.revert restores canonical native history and subsequent producer requests retain it
Official buildForkSeed and AgentRegistry.create create a durable loaded fork with inherited marker events and original parent lineage
The fork has no model request and has not entered agent/pre-step before restore
A trusted new NativeInstructions instance calls revert without apply and restores inherited native data
Inherited raw prefix remains unchanged and restoration cites marker plus original sequences
Physical JSONL readback matches every fork event and official Session reconstruction restores native instructions
Every complete request messages array and header equals its exact durable official JSONL prefix projection

limitations: Synthetic isolated official runtime only; no real desktop installation, reload or UI acceptance
Unloaded or crash-left persisted sessions are not proactively opened or automatically restored
Native producer still discovers and reads instruction files under strict policy

defectDetectedAndResolved.fix: Filter new native messages after pre-step; append historical builtin replacements in the official awaited agent/request callback after step/start and before request build
defectDetectedAndResolved.verified: All 28 complete requests reconstruct from physical JSONL after the change
